answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The bridge is the collateral at risk, the saffron the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the gale the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many saffron groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the bridge into smaller, individually useless stakes.
